source_boundary.subtitle: Radar vision for Copernicus
source_boundary.source_text_excerpt: The Copernicus Sentinel-1 mission is designed as a two-satellite constellation. Each satellite carries an advanced radar instrument to provide an all-weather, day-and-night supply of imagery of Earth’s surface.

narrow_claim: The official ESA Sentinel-1 mission page states that Sentinel-1 is a Copernicus radar mission providing all-weather, day-and-night Earth observation imagery.
limitations: This card verifies only the official ESA source-boundary claim.
It does not validate Sentinel-1 product accuracy.
It does not certify all Sentinel-1 applications.
It does not use non-ESA sources.
claim_boundary: The card verifies only that the official ESA Sentinel-1 mission page states the narrow mission-purpose claim: Copernicus Sentinel-1 is a radar mission providing all-weather, day-and-night Earth observation imagery.
